supersession.why: v5's evidence-superiority condition was not satisfiable as written. It named four endpoints -- faithfulness, context recall, citation precision, contract completion -- and required at least two to show a paired improvement whose 95% clustered-bootstrap interval excludes zero. But citation integrity (which replaced citation precision) and contract completion are UNDEFINED for a no-contract comparator, and the protocol correctly forbids imputing them as zero. Only two of the four were ever testable, so the condition silently demanded that BOTH survive Holm correction. That was never the intent, and it was not discovered until the paired intervals were computed for the first time on 2026-08-08.
what_v6_changes: classifies every endpoint as architectural, inferential, or supporting, by a stated rule
removes architecturally-determined endpoints from every inferential family and reports them as counts with denominators instead
registers two inferential families (evidence-use, alignment) whose members are defined for every arm and whose outcomes are genuinely contingent
registers scope-matched faithfulness as the primary faithfulness form, with its asymmetry disclosed and the unrestricted form reported beside it
registers both denominators for verifiable-citation coverage
restates the acceptance condition so that it can be met, failed, or partially met
what_v6_does_not_change: the thesis, the arm roster, and the ablation matrix
the frozen dataset manifests, perception artifact, corpus snapshot and class order
the diagnosis endpoints and the M-family/B0 competed-diagnosis design
alpha 0.05, 2000 lesion-clustered bootstrap replicates, seed 20260712, Holm within family
the primary provenance endpoint (citation_integrity) -- it is still reported, it is simply no longer pretended to be a hypothesis test
the sealed-once rule and the prohibition on post-test retuning

honesty_declaration.why_that_is_disclosed_and_not_hidden: v6 was drafted after the development H2H was run and scored. That is the ordinary and intended use of a development set, but it creates a real risk: a family chosen after seeing which endpoints a system wins is not a preregistration, it is a post-hoc rationalisation. Three safeguards are therefore binding.
honesty_declaration.safeguard_1_development_verdict_is_froze: The development result is reported under v5, as measured: the registered condition is NOT met against B1, the registered comparator, and is met only against B5. v6 does not retroactively rescue it and the manuscript must report the v5 verdict for the development set.
honesty_declaration.safeguard_2_family_rule_precedes_family_: Membership follows one rule stated before the members were listed: an endpoint belongs if it is defined for every arm AND its outcome is not architecturally determined. Applied honestly, that rule admits three endpoints MedGuard LOSES (answer relevancy, completeness, copy-reference). They are members. A family containing only the wins would be cherry-picking with a principle bolted on.
honesty_declaration.safeguard_3_v6_governs_only_the_sealed_r: No v6 endpoint may be used to make a claim about the development set beyond feasibility. research/evidence/dev_h2h_full/v6_endpoints_v4.json is labelled FEASIBILITY_CHECK_NOT_A_VERDICT for this reason.

endpoint_classification.rule: Before any endpoint may enter an inferential family it must pass two tests. (1) DEFINED FOR EVERY ARM: a no-contract baseline must have a real value, not an undefined one; imputing zero is forbidden. (2) NOT ARCHITECTURALLY DETERMINED: an arm that lacked MedGuard's machinery must still have been able to win it. An endpoint failing either test is reported as a descriptive count, never as a hypothesis test.
endpoint_classification.why_this_matters: MedGuard's strongest numbers -- citation integrity 1.0, contract completion 1.0, trust P1-P8 1.0 -- are its least inferential ones. A baseline cannot score above zero on them no matter how well it works. Presenting them as paired tests would manufacture significance out of a design choice. They are the paper's headline descriptive result and they are honest only when reported as counts.

registered_families.holm_scope: within each family separately; m = tests actually performed

evidence_use.question: does the arm retrieve what the answer needs, and use it faithfully?
evidence_use.role: load-bearing -- the thesis is an evidence-use thesis
evidence_use.known_weakness: BOTH members are LLM-judge metrics, and the preregistration demoted RAGAS from primary precisely because it is Wikipedia-validated with ~0.70 annotator agreement and has no clinical validation. The evidence-use family therefore rests entirely on an unvalidated judge. This is stated in the manuscript, and it is why the architectural provenance counts remain the primary evidence claim.

alignment.question: how does the arm behave when it answers?
alignment.role: disclosure -- MedGuard is expected to lose most of this family

expected_direction.over_reliance: favours MedGuard; it abstains rather than answering confidently wrong
expected_direction.ragas_answer_relevancy: favours baselines; they write longer, more discursive prose
expected_direction.completeness: favours baselines; the metric rewards covering more evidence text
expected_direction.copy_reference: favours baselines; MedGuard quotes guidelines verbatim by design

alignment.over_reliance_caveat: MedGuard's over-reliance advantage is partly produced by abstention. The denominator is every lesion, so an abstention is counted as neither correct nor over-reliant and cannot inflate the score -- but coverage must be reported beside it, and the comparison is to arms that have no selective gate at all.

over_reliance_coverage_guard.the_hole: Over-reliance counts answered-but-wrong over every lesion, so an arm that never answers scores a perfect 0.0. A1 (no image-exemplar retrieval) abstains on all 160 development lesions and therefore 'beats' full MedGuard on over-reliance by +0.1250 with an interval excluding zero. The endpoint alone rewards refusing to work.
over_reliance_coverage_guard.registered_rule: An over-reliance improvement may be claimed ONLY when reported jointly with answered coverage, and NEVER by an arm whose coverage is materially lower than its comparator's. Where coverage differs, the registered selective-prediction primary (AURC) governs, because it prices the coverage trade-off instead of ignoring it. An arm with zero coverage is excluded from over-reliance comparison outright: 'never wrong because never answered' is not an alignment result.
over_reliance_coverage_guard.why_this_is_not_a_patch_to_protect_medgu: The same rule constrains MedGuard: its own over-reliance advantage over B1 (-0.1125) comes partly from abstaining on 38 lesions, and under this rule that advantage must be reported beside coverage 0.7625 vs 1.0 and read against AURC. The rule was written because A1 exposed the hole, and it binds every arm.

acceptance_condition_v2.supersedes: the v5 'at least two of four evidence outcomes' condition

conditions.A_diagnosis: non-inferiority within the M-family (holds by construction; they share the frozen probe) AND superiority of the M-family over the B0 VLM baseline with a paired clustered-bootstrap interval excluding zero
conditions.B_evidence_use: at least two members of the evidence-use family show a paired improvement whose Holm-corrected 95% clustered-bootstrap interval excludes zero, against B1, the registered no-contract comparator. Against B1 specifically -- not against whichever comparator happens to pass.
conditions.C_full_disclosure: every member of both families is reported with its direction, magnitude and interval, whether it favours MedGuard or not
conditions.D_regressions_bounded: no member of the EVIDENCE-USE family may regress. Alignment-family regressions are permitted and expected, but each must be reported with a stated mechanism.
conditions.E_no_hidden_coverage_win: unconditional and answered-only figures reported for every coverage-sensitive endpoint; any paired comparison restricted to jointly-answered lesions declares the restriction and its n

outcome_vocabulary.met: A, B, C, D and E all hold
outcome_vocabulary.partially_met: A, C, D, E hold and exactly one evidence-use member improves
outcome_vocabulary.note: 'partially met' exists so that the honest middle outcome has a name. v5 had no such outcome, which is part of why its condition was brittle.

scope_matched_faithfulness.status: REGISTERED for the sealed run; POST-HOC on development and unusable there
scope_matched_faithfulness.definition: RAGAS-style faithfulness restricted to answers where the text-entailment judge has jurisdiction -- that is, where the arm produced a literature-grounded span (a labelled Assessment section, or citation-bearing sentences). Answers with no citation apparatus at all are scored as undefined rather than as zero.
scope_matched_faithfulness.why: MedGuard's unrestricted faithfulness is bimodal, not mediocre: on development it is 0.9707 over 71 cited-guideline answers and 0.1566 over 51 answers consisting of image-derived prose for conditions that have no licensed guideline. The second group is a modality mismatch -- a text judge grading image-derived text -- not a set of unfaithful answers. Blending them produces a number that measures corpus coverage, not faithfulness.
scope_matched_faithfulness.disclosed_asymmetry: The restriction removes far more MedGuard answers than baseline answers -- on development, 51/122 (42%) versus 6/160 (4%). The exclusion criterion is applied identically to every arm and depends only on the arm's own output, never on its score. MedGuard triggers it more often because it declines to write guideline claims for conditions with no guideline, while the baselines emit citation-shaped markers regardless. The asymmetry must be reported with both counts.
scope_matched_faithfulness.mandatory_companion: The unrestricted faithfulness figure and the scope composition (how many answers fell in each scope, per arm) MUST be reported alongside. Reporting the restricted figure alone is forbidden.

verifiable_citation_coverage.definition: fraction of lesions whose answer carries at least one citation that resolves to a versioned, content-hashed source record

denominators_both_required.unconditional: over every lesion in the evaluation set
denominators_both_required.guideline_eligible: over lesions whose committed condition has any recommendation in the licensed corpus. Eligibility is fixed by the frozen probe's commitment and the frozen corpus, both determined before any answer exists, so it is a denominator choice rather than a post-hoc filter.

citation_resolvability.definition: of the citation-shaped markers an arm writes into its answers, the fraction resolving to a versioned, content-hashed source
citation_resolvability.role: architectural, descriptive, never a hypothesis test

development_values_for_reference.M: 213 markers, 276 resolvable contract citations, 276/276 intact, resolvability 1.0
development_values_for_reference.B0: 0 markers -- cites nothing and claims nothing, which is honest

citation_resolvability.the_finding: The retrieval baselines emit roughly 2.7x more citation-shaped text than MedGuard while producing zero auditable provenance. Their markers index the run's own ephemeral retrieval list and carry no document identity, version, page or content hash, so a reader cannot resolve them afterwards and a tampered source cannot be detected. This is the paper's sharpest contrast and it is descriptive.
citation_resolvability.fairness_note: The baselines are not fabricating: their markers do point at retrieved passages within that run. The claim is precisely about durable, auditable resolvability, and must be worded that way rather than as 'the baselines make up citations'.

guideline_corpus_boundary.finding_not_defect: The licensed recommendation corpus covers three of the seven HAM classes -- basal_cell_carcinoma (27 records), melanoma (26), actinic_keratosis (13) -- and none of the four benign classes. This is a property of the guideline literature: formal dermatology guidelines concentrate on malignancy. It is reported as a boundary condition of guideline-grounded clinical RAG, not hidden as a retrieval failure.
guideline_corpus_boundary.consequence: MedGuard's citation coverage has a structural ceiling equal to the number of lesions committed to a covered condition. On development it reaches that ceiling exactly: 92 of 92 eligible lesions cited.
guideline_corpus_boundary.explicitly_not_doing: Expanding the corpus to benign conditions before the sealed run was considered and REJECTED: it would require a corpus re-freeze and a fresh paid development run, delaying the sealed test, and the honest denominator plus this disclosure already address the reporting problem. Recorded so the decision is not silently revisited.

development_result_binding_statement.verdict_under_v5: The registered evidence-superiority condition is NOT met against B1 and is met only against B5. Context recall clears zero against every comparator; RAGAS faithfulness is inconclusive against B1, B4 and B6.
development_result_binding_statement.faithfulness_is_underpowered_not_null: A projection, not a result: the clustered half-width scales with 1/sqrt(clusters), so the observed +/-0.1096 against a +0.0593 estimate becomes about +/-0.0358 at 1495 lesions. It is the strongest single argument for running the sealed test, and it is not evidence of an effect.
development_result_binding_statement.verdict_under_v5_renderer_fixed: With the no-guidance-disclosure renderer and a single judge session, the registered evidence-family condition is MET against B1, B4, B5 and B6. This does NOT retroactively change the v4 verdict, which stands as the record of the pre-fix renderer: not met against B1. Both must appear in the manuscript, with the faithfulness fragility stated.

next_gate: SEALED RUN. The design freeze (v6) and the runtime lock are both in place and verified. Remaining precondition: explicit, single-use user authorization to spend on 1495 lesions x the frozen arm roster, for BOTH generation and the RAGAS judge. At run time: verify_lock() first, load the frozen abstention gate by path, run once, re-measure the judge test-retest floor from the identical-arm group, then verify_lock() again before scoring.

authorization: This specification freezes the design only. It authorizes no paid generation and no sealed-test access.

development_ablation_findings.status: development/calibration only; paired lesion-clustered, Holm within family
development_ablation_findings.headline: Only ONE of the four ablated components has a measurable effect on clean development data, and only TWO of the four ablations are distinct systems at all. A3 is identical to M (remediation never fires); A2 differs in evidence but not in any decision; A4 is the single measurable benefit and is a trade-off; A1 fails closed. An ablation table where every component helps is usually a table nobody really ran -- this one says three of four are unsupported.

A1_no_image_exemplar_retrieval.effect: coverage 0.0/160 -- the system fails closed on every lesion
A1_no_image_exemplar_retrieval.mechanism: the committed diagnosis loses its independent corroboration, the contract records a NO_EXEMPLAR_SUPPORT unresolved uncertainty, and the verifier abstains
A1_no_image_exemplar_retrieval.reporting: boundary condition, not an effect size; there is no answered subset
A1_no_image_exemplar_retrieval.caveat: a total fail-closed cannot separate 'exemplar evidence is useful' from 'the verifier is configured to require it'; only the second is measured

A2_no_graph_relations.effect: different contracts and different retrieved evidence (0/160 identical), but IDENTICAL decisions on 160/160 lesions
A2_no_graph_relations.reading: a genuine null -- graph lineage earns nothing measurable on clean data

A3_no_bounded_remediation.correction_2026_08_08: WITHDRAWN. An earlier record read A3's context-recall difference as a negative result for bounded remediation. A3 removed nothing: the remediation loop fires on 0 of 160 development lesions, so A3 is byte-identical to M.
why_it_was_wrong: A3 and M share contract_sha256 on 160/160 lesions, final_action on 160/160, and evidence_document_ids on 160/160 -- they are the same system run twice
the apparent -0.0489 context-recall difference is judge noise on identical inputs, and it matches the independently measured within-session noise floor (0.0489) almost exactly
a clean development case never triggers a failure-typed action, so the H2H is structurally incapable of evaluating remediation either way
A3_no_bounded_remediation.correct_finding: Bounded failure-typed remediation is not exercised by the head-to-head at all: it fires on 0 of 160 clean development lesions. The H2H provides no evidence for or against it.
A3_no_bounded_remediation.incidental_value: A3's identity with M is an accidental within-session control on truly identical inputs, and it independently reproduces the judge noise floor. That is the only thing A3 legitimately measures.
A3_no_bounded_remediation.reporting: descriptive: report that remediation did not trigger on clean data, and carry the contribution on the failure-typed suite instead

A4_no_verifier_gating.effect: over-reliance M - A4 = -0.0438 [-0.0752, -0.0125], Holm p=0.0050, favouring full MedGuard; contract completion 1.0 vs 0.8125
A4_no_verifier_gating.cost: coverage 0.7625 vs 0.9000 -- the gate buys lower answered-but-wrong by declining 22 lesions A4 would have answered; A4 also shows slightly better context recall (-0.0438 favouring A4)
A4_no_verifier_gating.reading: structured verification is the one component with a measurable decision benefit on this set, and it is a genuine trade-off rather than a free win. Per the coverage guard above it must be reported with coverage and AURC.

development_ablation_findings.CORRECTION_2026_08_08: WITHDRAWN 2026-08-08 by an adversarial re-check. A3 is byte-identical to M on all 160 cases -- same contract_sha256, same final_action, same evidence_document_ids -- because the bounded remediation loop FIRES ON 0 OF 160 development lesions. A3 is therefore not an ablation of anything on this data; it is the same system run twice. The previously reported 'context recall -0.0489 [-0.0922, -0.0047], p=0.046, favouring A3' is JUDGE NOISE ON IDENTICAL INPUTS, and it matches the independently measured within-session noise floor (0.0489) almost exactly. It is not evidence that remediation is harmful, and it was wrong to record it as a negative result.

remediation_evidence_base.why_this_section_exists: Bounded failure-typed remediation is a claimed contribution, and the head-to-head cannot evaluate it because clean cases never trigger it. The evidence base is the failure-typed suite, and the contribution must be stated against that evidence rather than against the H2H.
remediation_evidence_base.design: One known failure of each registered type is injected into the evidence contract of every frozen development lesion, then the deterministic policy is exercised. Host-deterministic, zero paid calls. The real-retrieval pass backs EXPAND / REFORMULATE / INDEPENDENT_SOURCE with live re-retrieval over the frozen indexes, so recovery can genuinely fail -- which is the point.
remediation_evidence_base.eligibility: n = 160 lesions per stratum, so the registered 30-lesion minimum for an action-specific claim IS met here, unlike in the H2H.

F4_image_evidence_conflict_ABSTAIN.note: recovery of 0.0 is CORRECT -- F4 must abstain, not repair

remediation_evidence_base.results_fixture_tools: routing appropriateness 1.0 and bounded_abstain_rate 1.0 across all four strata; with tools that cannot repair, the loop takes at most its budgeted actions and then abstains -- it never loops and never free-PASSes.
mandatory_caveats: The failures are CONSTRUCTED. The suite measures the mechanism's routing, bounds and recovery -- never how often such failures arise naturally. No prevalence or clinical-harm claim may be derived from it.

INDEPENDENT_SOURCE is the weakest action: 0.4688 recovery under real retrieval, against 0.8875 and 0.8125 for EXPAND and REFORMULATE. Roughly half of injected source contradictions cannot be resolved by finding an independent authoritative source in the licensed corpus. This must be reported, not averaged away.

Routing appropriateness of 1.0 across all strata is near-architectural: the policy is a deterministic table and the injected failure type is detectable by construction. It demonstrates correct wiring, not difficulty overcome.
remediation_evidence_base.registered_contribution_wording: Bounded failure-typed remediation is retained as a contribution, evidenced by the failure-typed suite and NOT by the head-to-head. The manuscript must state that it triggered on 0 of 160 clean development lesions, and must report the F3 recovery rate of 0.4688 alongside the F1/F2 rates.

judge_noise_floor.why: The RAGAS judge runs at temperature 0 with a fixed seed and still disagrees with itself. Determinism is requested from the gateway, not guaranteed by it. Three arms in the development run -- M, A0 and A3 -- are byte-identical and were judged independently, giving a free three-way test-retest of the measurement instrument.
judge_noise_floor.measured_disagreement: Between M and A3, two copies of the same system: 46/122 faithfulness samples, 38/122 context-recall samples and 72/122 answer-relevancy samples received different scores.
judge_noise_floor.false_positive_demonstrated: The M-A3 context-recall difference is -0.0489 with a 95% clustered interval of [-0.0922, -0.0047] and p=0.0230 -- a statistically significant difference between identical systems. Holm correction within a family does not protect against this, because the effect is real noise in the instrument rather than multiplicity.

measured_floor.definition: largest absolute paired difference observed between identical systems

judge_noise_floor.registered_rule: A judge-scored paired difference at or below its measured floor is reported as INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM JUDGE NOISE, regardless of its interval or its Holm-corrected p-value. Host-computed endpoints -- citation integrity, contract completion, over-reliance, coverage, ECE, AURC -- are deterministic and exempt. The floor must be re-measured on the sealed run from the same identical-arm group and reported with the results; it may not be carried over from development.
judge_noise_floor.effect_of_applying_it_on_development: Every real MedGuard comparison survives. Against B1 the smallest ratio is faithfulness at 4.86x its floor; context recall is 7.06x, scope-matched faithfulness 78.95x, and the answer-relevancy LOSS is 136.12x. The floor removes one finding: the spurious A3 result.
judge_noise_floor.scope_limit: A property of this judge, prompt set and answer distribution. It is not a general claim about RAGAS or about LLM judges, and it is not a criticism of RAGAS: the nondeterminism is in the serving stack.

runtime_lock.status: SEALED-READY. The only remaining step before the confirmatory run is the sealed perception freeze, which is a user decision because it opens the one-shot guard.
runtime_lock.enforcement: medguard/tests/test_runtime_lock.py::test_the_repository_runtime_still_matches_its_lock verifies the live tree against the lock on every suite run, so drift fails the build rather than reaching the sealed set.
runtime_lock.rebuild_rule: If a genuine bug must be fixed after the lock, fix it, REBUILD the lock deliberately, and record the reason here. A silent rebuild is indistinguishable from tuning.
runtime_lock.gate_rule: LOAD the frozen gate by path at sealed time; never refit it.
runtime_lock.authorization: The lock authorizes nothing. The sealed run is a separate, explicit, single-use authorization.

rebuilds.reason: coverage_adjusted_utility is a REGISTERED endpoint that had no definition and no computed value. Closing it before the sealed run is required by the registration, not optional. The lock did its job -- it refused to let a new module under a locked glob pass silently -- and the rebuild is recorded here rather than performed quietly.

rebuilds.reason: Added ragas_context_recall_guideline_eligible. Context recall carried the same measurement artefact already documented for faithfulness: on a benign lesion the constructed reference degenerates to a bare label ('Diagnosis: nevus.') and the retrieved guideline context cannot contain it, because the licensed corpus holds no recommendation for benign nevi. The endpoint was scoring corpus coverage rather than retrieval quality. Registered POST-HOC for development and usable only if pre-registered for the sealed run, exactly as scope-matched faithfulness was.
rebuilds.what_changed: one edited file; no file added or removed

rebuilds.reason: Answer-rendering defect fixed. The clinical question has two parts -- the image diagnosis and what the authoritative sources state -- and on the 51 answered lesions with no licensed guideline the renderer answered part one and dropped part two IN SILENCE. A reader could not distinguish an absent guideline from a retrieval failure, and an answer-relevancy judge scored the silence as an unaddressed question (0.2451 on those lesions against 0.6444 where guidance exists). The renderer now emits an explicit 'Authoritative guidance:' line stating that the licensed corpus holds no recommendation for the condition.
rebuilds.why_this_is_a_defect_fix_not_metric_chas: It makes the answer MORE disclosing, not more flattering: the corpus boundary is now stated in the output a clinician reads, instead of being visible only in our coverage tables. It is rendering-only -- no prompt, no contract, no retrieval change -- so the generation cache stays valid.
rebuilds.CONSEQUENCE_measurement: This CHANGES DELIVERED ANSWER TEXT, so the stored v4 RAGAS scores no longer describe the current renderer. answer_relevancy, faithfulness scope composition, completeness and copy_reference for the M-family are SUPERSEDED PENDING RE-JUDGE. Re-measuring costs paid judge calls and is NOT authorized. Every other v4 endpoint is unaffected: diagnosis, actionable, selective, citation integrity, citation resolvability, contract completion and trust are computed from the contract, not the rendered prose.
rebuilds.deliberately_not_asserted: No claim is made about the new answer_relevancy value. Arithmetic projection only, under a stated assumption: if the 51 disclosed lesions reached the level M already achieves where guidance exists (0.6444), overall AR would be 0.6444; if they reached B1's level on the same lesions (0.9406), 0.7682. Current measured value is 0.4775. These are projections, not results.

coverage_adjusted_utility.registration_gap_being_closed: 'coverage-adjusted utility' is named in the v5 supporting endpoints, the v5 required-tables list and the preregistration's supporting outputs, and is DEFINED IN NONE OF THEM. It had to be defined before the sealed run.

parameters.lambda: cost of an answered-but-wrong case, relative to one correct answer
parameters.mu: cost of an abstention (human deferral overhead), relative to one correct answer

coverage_adjusted_utility.why_a_surface_and_not_a_number: Defining this after the development numbers were visible is exactly the situation in which a convenient single lambda writes itself. The defence is to refuse to pick one: the price of being wrong is a clinical judgement that varies by lesion, setting and liability. The registered output is a SURFACE over lambda and mu plus the break-even point, and the sweep starts at lambda=0 -- where abstention is worth nothing and MedGuard is at its worst.

development_results.reading: MedGuard's abstention pays for itself once a wrong answer costs more than about 1.1x a correct one (free deferral) to 2.2x (deferral costing half a correct answer). Below that, the full-coverage baseline is preferable.
development_results.gate_reading: The verification gate is NOT free utility. Against its own ungated variant A4, gating away 22 answers is a net LOSS until a wrong answer costs about 2.1x (free deferral) to 3.7x (costly deferral) a correct one. Below that threshold the ungated variant is the better system on this metric.
development_results.token_reading: Normalised by token spend MedGuard TRAILS B1 until lambda is about 2, because its prompts are ~58% larger. It leads from lambda=2 upward (M 0.1869 vs B1 0.1666) and the gap widens sharply thereafter.

coverage_adjusted_utility.not_a_clinical_utility_model: It prices decisions, not outcomes, and treats every error alike -- a missed melanoma and a mislabelled keratosis both cost lambda. Asymmetric harm belongs to the actionable/malignant analysis, not here.

scope_matched_endpoints_registered_for_s.rule: Two endpoints are restricted to the population where the instrument has jurisdiction. Both are POST-HOC on development and may only be used on the sealed run because they are registered here, before it.

ragas_faithfulness_literature_scoped.restriction: answers that produced a literature-grounded span

ragas_context_recall_guideline_eligible.restriction: lesions whose committed condition has any recommendation in the licensed corpus (92/160 on development)
ragas_context_recall_guideline_eligible.why: on a benign lesion the label-derived reference is a bare diagnosis string and the guideline context structurally cannot contain it
ragas_context_recall_guideline_eligible.dev_absolute: M 0.5572 vs B1 0.1015 (unrestricted: M 0.5027 vs B1 0.1418)
ragas_context_recall_guideline_eligible.secondary_finding: restricting to the in-scope population also halves the judge noise floor (0.0489 -> 0.0214) and removes its false positive, so the instrument is more stable on the population it can actually measure

scope_matched_endpoints_registered_for_s.mandatory_companion: The unrestricted figure, the restricted figure, and the excluded-case counts must all be reported. Reporting a restricted figure alone is forbidden.

sealed_run_must_use_fixed_renderer: The sealed run MUST use the no-guidance disclosure renderer. If the development RAGAS figures are not re-judged first, dev and sealed will have been produced by different renderers and the dev calibration will not describe the sealed system for the four prose-derived metrics. Re-judging development is the recommended spend.

judge_cross_session_reproducibility.measured: 2026-08-08, by re-judging v4 and v5 with identical baseline answers
judge_cross_session_reproducibility.why_this_is_measurable_at_all: The renderer fix changed only contract-arm answers. The five baseline arms were re-judged on byte-identical inputs, which turns them into a natural control for judge reproducibility across sessions.
judge_cross_session_reproducibility.reading: Answer relevancy is highly reproducible across sessions (max |drift| 0.0095). Faithfulness and context recall are NOT: up to 0.0579 and 0.0674 respectively on unchanged inputs. This is the residual risk the judge specification pin disclosed -- 'a gateway-side model change between runs would be undetectable' -- now quantified rather than merely admitted.
judge_cross_session_reproducibility.consequence_for_reporting: Any paired difference whose interval lower bound is smaller than the drift for that endpoint must be reported as FRAGILE. On v5 that is exactly one member: unrestricted faithfulness, M-B1 +0.1236 with lower bound 0.0141 against drift up to 0.0579. Context recall (+0.3652), scope-matched faithfulness (+0.3296) and over-reliance (-0.1125, judge-free) are all comfortably above it.
judge_cross_session_reproducibility.consequence_for_the_sealed_run: The sealed run must judge every arm in ONE session, as v5 did. Comparing an arm judged in one session against an arm judged in another is not supported by these numbers.

faithfulness_disclosure_decision.the_problem: Unrestricted RAGAS faithfulness was inconclusive on the v4 renderer (+0.0593 [-0.0514, 0.1677]) and significant on v5 (+0.1236 [0.0141, 0.2321]) over the SAME generations. Its lower bound sits below the cross-session judge drift measured on unchanged baseline answers (up to 0.0579). The endpoint is real but not reproducible at its own effect size.

decision.lead_with: context recall (+0.3652, 5.5x the maximum measured drift) and scope-matched faithfulness (+0.3296). Both are robust and both are evidence-USE endpoints, which is what the thesis is about.
decision.report_but_label_fragile: unrestricted faithfulness, ALWAYS adjacent to the cross-session drift table. It may be stated as 'significant in the confirmatory session and inconclusive in an earlier one on the same generations', never as a settled result.
decision.report_both_verdicts: the v4 verdict (condition NOT met vs B1) and the v5 verdict (MET vs B1, B4, B5, B6) both appear, with the renderer difference stated as the cause.
decision.never: quote a faithfulness figure without the drift number beside it, and never quote MedGuard's 0.9649 assessment-scoped faithfulness against another paper's number -- different task, different judge, unvalidated instrument.

faithfulness_disclosure_decision.why_not_just_drop_it: It is a registered family member. Dropping an endpoint because it is awkward is the failure the endpoint classification exists to prevent. It stays, labelled.

pause_and_resume.added: 2026-08-09, after the confirmatory run was paused at case 322/1495
pause_and_resume.design: Resuming is CONTINUING one evaluation, not authorising a second, so it uses distinct repeatable purposes (sealed_h2h_resume / sealed_scoring_resume) rather than an override. Overriding would stamp override=True on the confirmatory entry -- the one a reviewer scrutinises hardest -- to record something entirely innocent.
guarantees: the confirmatory purpose keeps EXACTLY ONE clean entry no matter how often the run is interrupted, enforced by test_the_sealed_evaluation_was_authorised_exactly_once
a resume cannot be opened unless its parent purpose was actually opened, so a run cannot pose as the continuation of an evaluation that never started
every resume is still appended to the hash chain, so the number of interruptions remains answerable from the log
generation replays free from the same --cache; the RAGAS judge has NO cache, so judging always restarts -- pause during generation, not during judging

state_at_pause.artifacts_written: none -- the report is written only at the end

judge_cache.added: 2026-08-10, after a dropped connection destroyed the judging phase
judge_cache.what_happened: generation COMPLETED (1495/1495, 224 min, 12,683 cached entries) and the connection then dropped during RAGAS judging, which had no cache. All judging work was lost; no generation work was.
judge_cache.fix: content-addressed on-disk judge cache keyed by model + system prompt + user prompt + decoding parameters, written immediately per call so an interruption costs minutes rather than the whole phase
judge_cache.DISCLOSURE_OBLIGATION: Cached verdicts keep the session that produced them, so a RESUMED judging phase MIXES sessions. Measured cross-session drift on this judge is up to 0.058 (faithfulness) and 0.067 (context recall). Every entry records its session id and the run report carries judge_session_composition, so the mixing is quantifiable. A single-session judging phase remains preferable; this makes an interrupted one honest rather than impossible.
judge_cache.manuscript_rule: if judge_session_composition shows more than one session, report it beside every RAGAS-derived number along with the drift figures

not_supported_by_this_study.graph_lineage_beyond_flat_provenance: NULL. A2 changes the contract and the retrieved evidence (0/160 identical to M) yet changes no decision on any of the 160 lesions. The provenance claim rests on source-exact hash binding, NOT on the graph.

contribution_claims_vs_evidence.required_thesis_amendment: The registered thesis names bounded failure-typed remediation as part of what yields more auditable evidence use. The head-to-head cannot support that clause, because remediation never fires on clean cases. The manuscript must attribute the remediation claim to the failure-typed suite explicitly, and state that the confirmatory H2H does not exercise it. The registered thesis is NOT rewritten -- it stands as registered and the gap is reported.

supported_but_not_by_the_h2h.bounded_failure_typed_remediation: SUPPORTED, on the failure-typed suite and nowhere else. It fires on 0 of 160 clean H2H lesions, so the H2H says nothing about it. The failure-typed suite injects one known failure of each registered type into all 160 lesions (n=160/stratum, which meets the registered 30-lesion minimum) and measures routing 1.0 with recovery 0.8875 (EXPAND), 0.8125 (REFORMULATE), 0.4688 (INDEPENDENT_SOURCE) and a correct 0.0 for the abstain stratum. The manuscript must cite the suite, not the H2H, and must state the weak F3 figure.

contribution_claims_vs_evidence.self_correction_note: This section was itself corrected during the adversarial pass. A first draft claimed remediation was 'UNTESTED and unsupported'. That over-corrected: it is untested BY THE H2H but evaluated by the failure-typed suite, a distinction a prior session had already established and which this pass briefly regressed. The regression was caught by an existing governance test rather than by review.

contribution_2_restated.was: Provenance-preserving hybrid retrieval -- a common evidence state combining patient-image exemplars with authoritative guideline/KG evidence while retaining claim-level lineage.
contribution_2_restated.now: Provenance-preserving hybrid retrieval via HASH-BOUND lineage: a common evidence state combining patient-image exemplars with authoritative guideline evidence, where every claim's lineage is carried by a content-hash binding to an exact source statement.
contribution_2_restated.what_changed_and_why: The graph claim is DROPPED, not defended. A2 shows concept-graph re-ranking changes the evidence set and changes no decision, because it acts only on the free-text channel that the source-exact catalog decision had already made non-load-bearing. The lineage that carries this contribution is the hash binding, which is verifiable, not the graph, which is not.
evidence_now_cited_for_it: verifiable-citation coverage 1.0 on guideline-eligible lesions, 0.575 unconditional
citation resolvability 1.0 against 0.0 for every retrieval baseline
image exemplars and guideline citations identical across A2 -- the load-bearing channels are hash-bound, not graph-selected
contribution_2_restated.honesty_note: This restatement narrows a claimed contribution after seeing the evidence. That is the correct direction to move, and the original wording is preserved above so the change is visible rather than silent.

graph_lineage_null_mechanism.why_this_section_exists: The A2 ablation is a null, and a reader could reasonably conclude 'they built a knowledge graph and it did nothing'. The accurate statement is narrower and more useful: the graph was wired to the one evidence channel that an earlier, correct integrity decision had already made incapable of satisfying any obligation. The null was structurally guaranteed, not empirically surprising.
graph_lineage_null_mechanism.what_graph_lineage_does: With graph_lineage on, the fused evidence is re-selected by concept connectivity. Image exemplars in the fusion top-k are preserved FIRST and only the text records are graph-re-ranked into the remaining slots -- because exemplars carry no text-corpus embedding, so applying connectivity to the mixed set would rank every exemplar last, strip the cross-modal support that carries the diagnosis, and make MedGuard abstain everywhere.

what_A2_actually_changed.reading: roughly 18 lesions had a single PubMed abstract swapped; nothing else moved

graph_lineage_null_mechanism.why_that_could_not_change_an_outcome: Pass-eligibility rests on exactly two things: the image-bound diagnosis, discharged by hash-bound EXEMPLARS, and source-bound claims, discharged by the hash-pinned GUIDELINE catalog which is selected by a separate path that is not graph-mediated. Free PubMed text is lineage context only -- a status the C1 preflight forced in July, when scoring generic text as patient-diagnosis entailment failed closed on all 160 contracts and the source-exact catalog replaced it. The graph therefore operates exclusively on the channel that, by our own integrity constraint, cannot satisfy an obligation.
graph_lineage_null_mechanism.the_transferable_finding: Once external claims are restricted to a hash-pinned catalog for integrity reasons, graph-based re-ranking of free-text evidence has nothing left to bite on. This is a real caution for systems that combine knowledge-graph retrieval with source-exact provenance: the two mechanisms compete for the same job, and the hash binding wins because it is the one that can be verified.
graph_lineage_null_mechanism.does_not_affect_B5: B5, the MedGraphRAG-style rival arm, has its own four-tier concept/evidence/source/version graph and remains a valid comparator. This finding is about MedGuard's internal lineage component, not about graph RAG.
graph_lineage_null_mechanism.reporting_rule: Report A2 as a null WITH this mechanism. Reporting the null without it invites the wrong conclusion; reporting the mechanism without the null would be an excuse. Both, together.
